topic: 社区服务与问题解决 · Independent new scenario: a team assessing the reliability of environmental forecasts
grammarFocus: 第一、第二条件句的常见用途；建议与可能性的表达。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Checking the Forecast: A Community Environmental Panel
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题，也不对应任何官方分数。请先听/读对话，完成10道听力题；然后学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。听力部分注意不同说话者的自然轮换与修正。
transcript:
Maya: Okay, everyone, thanks for coming. The city wants our community panel to judge how reliable the new environmental forecasts are. Let's start with the river-level model. Priya, you tested it last month, right?
Priya: Yes. I compared its predictions with the actual gauge readings for thirty days. On most days it was close, but on two days it was off by more than half a meter. If the model had used the newer rainfall data, those two days would probably have been better.
Maya: Good point. So what do you suggest we tell the city?
Priya: I suggest we ask them to update the rainfall input before the spring floods. If they update it now, the forecasts will be much safer.
Tom: Can I add something? I looked at the air-quality forecast. It was reliable for the city center, but it missed a pollution spike near the industrial park. If we add one more sensor there, we will catch those spikes earlier.
Maya: That sounds practical. But we should also think about cost. Daniel, you spoke to the budget office. What did they say?
Daniel: They said they can fund one new sensor this year, not two. So we have to choose. I'd recommend the industrial-park sensor, because the health risk there is higher.
Maya: Okay. Now, the heat-wave alert system. Elena, any problems?
Elena: Actually, yes. The alerts arrived on time, but the language was too technical. Many older residents didn't understand the advice. If the messages were shorter and in plain language, more people would follow them.
Tom: Sorry, can I correct something? I said earlier the alerts were late, but I checked again. They were on time. The problem was only the wording.
Maya: Thanks for the correction, Tom. That's important. So, to summarize: the river model needs better rainfall data; the air-quality network needs one more sensor near the industrial park; and the heat alerts need simpler language. Priya, can you draft the recommendations?
Priya: Sure. I'll send a draft by Friday. If everyone sends me their notes by Wednesday, I can finish it on time.
Daniel: I'll send mine tomorrow.
Elena: Me too.
Maya: Great. Let's meet again next Monday to review the draft. Thanks, everyone.

grammar.title: 第一、第二条件句的常见用途；建议与可能性的表达
grammar.explanation: 先看意思，再看术语。第一条件句说“如果……就……”，事情很可能发生，结构是 if + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can/may + 动词原形。例如：If they update it now, the forecasts will be much safer. 第二条件句说“假如……（但不太可能或与现在相反）”，结构是 if + 一般过去时，主句用 would/could/might + 动词原形。例如：If the messages were shorter, more people would follow them. 注意：if 从句里不用 will 或 would。表达建议常用 I suggest we... / I'd recommend... / we should...；表达可能性常用 will / may / might / could。
grammar.example: If they update it now, the forecasts will be much safer.

questions.prompt: If the team ______ the data today, the report will be ready tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will。
questions.evidence: If they update it now, the forecasts will be much safer.

questions.prompt: If I ______ more time, I would visit every sensor site.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句：if 从句用一般过去时，主句用 would + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If the messages were shorter and in plain language, more people would follow them.

questions.prompt: Choose the best suggestion: ______ we ask the city for two more sensors?
questions.explanation: Should we...? 是提出建议的常见说法。
questions.evidence: I suggest we ask them to update the rainfall input before the spring floods.

questions.prompt: If the alerts ______ simpler, older residents would understand them.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句：if 从句用一般过去时（be 动词用 were），主句用 would。
questions.evidence: If the messages were shorter and in plain language, more people would follow them.

questions.prompt: We ______ finish the draft by Friday if everyone sends notes by Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句可用 can 表示可能性；这里事情很可能发生。
questions.evidence: If everyone sends me their notes by Wednesday, I can finish it on time.

options: The sensor is near the park.
Priya tested the model last month.
questions.explanation: I'd recommend... 是表达建议的句型；其余是陈述事实。
questions.evidence: I'd recommend the industrial-park sensor, because the health risk there is higher.

questions.prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, the outdoor sensor check will move inside.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will。
questions.evidence: If they update it now, the forecasts will be much safer.

questions.prompt: If I were the mayor, I ______ fund two sensors.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句：if 从句用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If the messages were shorter and in plain language, more people would follow them.

Explain why you suggest it and what might happen if they do not make the change. Use at least one first conditional and one second conditional sentence.
